generalize_not_special_case.rule: Current special-case fragment ops are migration targets, not compatibility promises.

fastmath_opt_in.rule: Default math is exact/conservative; approximate SFU-derived math requires an explicit fastmath/approx contract.

vdw_sparse_store_deferred.rule: Arbitrary sparse VDW stores deterministic-reject until a later hardware-proven phase.

no_tile_dsl.rule: VC4Kernel is not a producer tile DSL and does not resurrect VC4Tile.

only_vc4kernel_to_ssavc4.rule: The only accepted lower path is vc4kernel -> ssavc4 -> scheduled vc4 -> artifacts/runtime/hardware.

hardware_or_deterministic_reject_require.rule: Every Surface v2 feature requires verifier, conversion, lower-half coverage where needed, and hardware proof or deterministic-reject proof.

features.current_surface: P9d hardware-proves VC4Kernel QPU VPM read/write w8/w16 packed and laned modes, with explicit width/subword/orientation/x/stride attrs. w32 requires subword<none>; w8/w16 require packed or laned. Horizontal w16 x is limited to halfword selectors [0,1], horizontal w8 x is limited to byte selectors [0,3], vertical x remains [0,15], and stride must fit the VPM QPU setup field.
features.target_surface: Executable VPM subword modes only after hardware proof and exact verifier coverage.
features.vc4kernel_verifier_plan: Accept exactly w32/none and hardware-proven w8/w16 packed/laned QPU VPM modes; reject meaningless or unencodable width/subword/x/stride combinations.
features.vc4kernel_to_ssavc4_plan: Lower admitted subword QPU modes to SSAVC4 VPM attrs without changing VDR/VDW DMA subword policy.
features.ssavc4_to_vc4_plan: Encode generic QPU VPM setup using hardware-derived SIZE, LANED, HORIZ, STRIDE, and ADDR fields; reject unencodable combinations before emission.
features.hardware_or_reject_verification_plan: P9d hardware proof covers w16/w8 packed/laned QPU read/write modes and deterministic-reject tests cover unsupported combinations.
features.upstream_use: Sub-32 storage movement after pre-vector lock.
features.migration_or_removal: Old blanket sub-32 QPU VPM executable rejection is replaced by precise P9d accepted/rejected mode rules; VDR/VDW DMA subword modes remain for P9e.
features.acceptance_line: P9 VPM subword modes are accepted only when each executable mode has hardware proof.
